class.name: RoadVehicleController
class.description: No rails, couplers or cabs, and no backend: it moves by its own kinematics, its velocity going towards the one [RoadVehicleServer] allows within [member acceleration_limit]. Where it is on the road, what is ahead of it and how fast that lets it go are [RoadVehicleServer]'s, which steps every road vehicle in one loop. What is driven from outside comes as commands: [code]wanted_velocity_set[/code] (km/h) and [code]side_offset_set[/code] (m).

method.name: get_brake_force_ratio
method.description: How hard it brakes against its acceleration limit [0-1] - what a driver's brake would give: it has no brakes of its own.

method.name: get_engine_revolutions
method.description: The engine's revolutions [1/s]: the wheels' times [member transmission_ratio].

method.name: get_side_offset
method.description: Its place across the road [m], from the road's centre line to the right of the way it travels.

method.name: get_throttle
method.description: How much it accelerates against its acceleration limit [0-1] - what a driver's throttle would give: it has no engine of its own.

method.name: get_wheels_angle_deg
method.description: How far its wheels have turned by the distance run [deg, 0-360).

method.name: horns_set
method.description: The [code]horns_set[/code] command: the horns sounding now.

method.name: lights_set
method.description: The [code]lights_set[/code] command: the lights it has on.

method.name: side_offset_set
method.description: The [code]side_offset_set[/code] command: its place across the road [m], to the right of the way it travels.

method.name: wanted_velocity_set
method.description: The [code]wanted_velocity_set[/code] command: the velocity it wants [km/h], 0 or more; what is ahead may let it go slower.

members.member: The acceleration and the deceleration it never exceeds [m/s2] - it brakes for what is ahead with it as well.
The gap it keeps to the vehicle ahead in its lane [m].
How far ahead it looks for what slows it down [m]: the vehicles ahead, the roads' limits, the end of its road.
How many times its engine turns for a turn of the wheels.
Its wheels' diameter [m]; none turn without one.

constants.constant: The head lights at its front.
The tail lights at its rear.
